svg.title: Scene 22: Six ways to identify a thing
svg.desc: Four frames comparing six technologies side by side: a passive RFID tag, an NFC tag or card, a QR code, a printed serial number, a Bluetooth LE beacon and a GPS tracker. First, what powers each and its typical range: the reader’s signal or field for RFID and NFC, no power for the printed codes, its own battery for the beacon and the tracker. Second, what each reveals and to whom. Third, whether it knows its own location: only the GPS tracker does, by computing it from satellites and reporting it over a cellular network; everything else is merely detected where a reader, camera, person or phone happens to be.
svg.text: Being detected near a reader is not the same as

the app that hears it, and its operator
